description: List the playlist folders in your Apple Music library: the top level, or the sub-folders of one folder. Each has its folder id (p.…, for apple_music_list_playlists folderId, apple_music_create_folder parentFolderId and apple_music_move_playlist), name and dateAdded, plus how many playlists sit directly in the folder. Needs APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN or web-player mode.

folderId.description: List this folder's sub-folders (default "root", the top level).

name: apple_music_list_folders
title: List your Apple Music playlist folders
